envelope.description: Add ResolvedTarget + ConfigSourceLayer shared types (reuse ExternalProtocol)

body.title: Add ResolvedTarget + ConfigSourceLayer shared types (reuse ExternalProtocol)
body.summary: In src/shared/types.ts add `export type ResolvedTarget = { resolved: true; protocol: ExternalProtocol; identity: string } | { resolved: false; rawExpression: string }` and `export type ConfigSourceLayer = 'k8s' | 'docker' | 'envFile' | 'localConfig'`, reusing the existing ExternalProtocol (added by S001, types.ts:551). These are the sc2 shared vocabulary consumed by s3/s4/s5. Scaffold the new module dir src/indexer/target-resolution/ with an internal `type ConfigSourceMap = Map<string, { value: string; layer: ConfigSourceLayer }>` (not shared).
acceptanceChecks: src/shared/types.ts exports ResolvedTarget (discriminated on resolved) and ConfigSourceLayer with exactly the four members; ExternalProtocol is reused, not re-declared
src/indexer/target-resolution/ exists with the internal ConfigSourceMap type

tests.name: type-surface: ResolvedTarget discriminates on `resolved`; ConfigSourceLayer has exactly 'k8s'|'docker'|'envFile'|'localConfig' (frozen-vocabulary fixture); ExternalProtocol reused from S001
